name: Sourcery
tagline: AI reviewer for GitHub and GitLab with line-by-line reviews, summaries and diagrams, custom rules, and BYO-LLM on its Team tier.
pricing: Free forever for public/open-source repos; Pro $12/seat/mo (annual, $15 monthly) adds private-repo reviews, higher review limits, Jira integration; Team $24/seat/mo (annual, $30 monthly) adds nightly scans of 50 repos, an issues dashboard, on-demand scans, and team analytics; Enterprise custom adds self-hosting, GitHub Enterprise Server, SSO, and BYO-LLM. 14-day Team trial, no card required.
selfHostedNote: Enterprise adds self-hosting; below that it is cloud-only.
modelControl: BYO-LLM is now Enterprise-only (moved off Team); vendor models on Pro and Team tiers

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: PR-scoped reviews; shallower context than codebase-indexing tools per our comparison.

02-rule-centric.note: Customizable review rules supported; enforcement depth not detailed in sources we verified.

03-dual-workflow.note: IDE/local review surface not covered in the sources we verified.

05-continuous-learning.note: Learning from review feedback not documented.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented sandbox validation; Team tier adds daily security scans.

07-economic-transparency.note: BYO-LLM is Enterprise-only (custom pricing); not offered on Pro or Team.

08-actionability.note: Fix-apply flow not documented in the sources we verified.

09-measurable-roi.note: Team tier adds repo analytics; ROI/DORA-level reporting not documented.
